items.quote: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
items.claim: In the text, the LORD asks whether to hide from Abraham what He is about to do.
items.action: asks whether to hide His intended action

items.quote: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation
items.claim: The text says Abraham will become a great and mighty nation, and gives this as a reason not to hide the plan from him.
items.object: Abraham becoming a great and mighty nation

items.quote: and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
items.claim: The text says all the nations of the earth will be blessed in Abraham.
items.object: blessing of all nations through Abraham

items.quote: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him,
items.claim: The LORD says He knows Abraham will command his children and household after him.
items.object: his children and his household after him

items.quote: and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment;
items.claim: The text says Abraham's descendants and household will keep the way of the LORD by doing justice and judgment.
items.action: keep the way of the LORD

items.quote: that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
items.claim: The text links the promise to Abraham to his household keeping justice and judgment: they do this so that the LORD may carry out what He promised.
items.mechanism: Abraham teaches his household, the household keeps justice and judgment, and so the LORD fulfils His promise
